versions.changelog:
- Initial release introducing the "memory-systems-hardened" skill for designing and implementing advanced agent memory systems.
- Compares production frameworks (Mem0, Zep/Graphiti, Letta, LangMem, Cognee) with detailed trade-offs and benchmark results.
- Provides guidance on building layered memory architectures, including working, short-term, long-term, entity, and temporal knowledge graph layers.
- Offers practical decision guidance for choosing and scaling memory architectures based on reliability and retrieval needs.
- Details hybrid and specialized retrieval strategies, memory consolidation practices, and best practices for integrating memory with agent context.
